verdict.rationale: Motion documents custom availability through a drag-and-drop interface, ideal meeting windows such as meeting-free Fridays, and custom time windows for tasks. Together these cover the working-hours part of an availability schedule. Nothing in the evidence describes date-specific overrides or out-of-office periods. Missing for 10: date overrides, out-of-office periods, detailed docs on configuring working hours, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can define availability schedules with working hours, date overrides, and out-of-office periods

citations.quote: Create custom availability in seconds with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface
Set your ideal meeting windows. Whether you prefer focused mornings, back-to-back afternoons, or meeting-free Fridays
Create custom time windows for your tasks and watch Motion slot them in perfectly
